author: DTrim99
body:
Confirmed — this is a PolicyEngine bug. We compute the CalEITC on California earned income only ($8,839 → $1,247) and skip the federal-AGI comparison. The CalEITC Worksheet line 6 (FTB 3514 instructions) says to take the *smaller* of the credit figured on earned income (line 2) and on federal AGI (line 5) — and because the $1,343 of interest pushes AGI ($10,182) above earned income and both sit in the CalEITC phase-out, the AGI-based credit ($861 on your Form 540, line 75) is the smaller and controls.

We'll fix `ca_eitc` to take the smaller of the earned-income and AGI credits, matching the worksheet (and how we already handle the federal EITC). Fix is up as PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#9363; I'll ping you here when it merges so you can rerun.
